headline: Moroccan immigrants in Spain send 1,589 million euros a year to families — almost 1% of GDP
summary: Bank of Spain data show remittances from Moroccan immigrants in Spain total EUR 1.589 billion a year, almost 1% of GDP. These transfers have grown significantly in recent years alongside the Moroccan population in Spain.
why: Remittances are a notable cross-border capital flow, affecting household income in recipient countries and payment-flow data tracked by Spanish and Moroccan economic analysts.
